capabilities: Sync Apple Books highlights automatically on startup
Run a manual sync from the command palette
Trigger a sync from a left-ribbon book icon
problem: Highlights made in Apple Books are stored in the app and must be copied into notes by hand.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired from the obsidian-kindle-plugin.

summary: Syncs your Apple Books highlights into the vault on startup, via command, or from a ribbon button.
